welcome.headline:
Ideas to Specs.
Specs to Product.
welcome.subheadline: Draft PRDs and system specs through conversation, then build implementation and deliverables aligned to the spec.
welcome.feature1Desc: Turn an idea into a PRD, and connect it to system design.
welcome.feature2Desc: Generate code, tests, and documentation aligned to your spec.
welcome.feature3Desc: Review outputs together and iteratively refine the spec.
